verdict.rationale: Vercel documents identity-provider based securing of deployments/agents (vercel-docs-13) and community evidence confirms Vercel has environment-variable settings that can be reviewed/rotated (vercel-comm-5), plus a report that deeper connection security is gated behind an 'enterprise' sales conversation (vercel-comm-11), suggesting tiered team/secrets controls exist. However there is no first-party documentation describing team roles/permissions, a centralized secrets manager, or an environment-variables dashboard workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on team roles/RBAC, secrets/env var management UI, and independent confirmation these work well at scale.
